paite: Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Job Thugen Sagihveina

paite: Tuni mahmah in ka phunna helhuai ahi, ka mauna sang in ka thuakna agikzaw hi.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

paite: Aw amah ka muhna mun thei leng la, atutna mahmah ah hoh thei leng aw!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

paite: Ama ah ka thu ka bawlhoih dia, thugente in ka kam dimsak ding hi veng.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

paite: Ahon na dawnna ding thute ka thei dia, huchi in bang ahia ka kiang a agen ding ka theisiam ding.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

paite: Athilhihtheihna thupina in kei ahon sel diam? Ii, himahleh kei hon hatsak ding hi.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

paite: Huai ah midik in amah thu asutpih thei dia; huchi in ka vaihawmmi a pan suahtaksak in ka om tawntungta ding hi.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

paite: "Ngai in, mailam zuan in ka pai a, himahleh huai ah a-om kei; nunglam zuan in, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

paite: Veilam pang ah, na sep lai in, himahleh amah ka mu thei kei a; taklam pang ah abu, amah ka muh theihlouhna ding in.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

paite: Himahleh ka zuih lampi athei a; ahon ze-et lai in, dangka-eng bang in ka hon suakkhe ding hi.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

paite: Ka khe in akalsuante alenkip a; alampite ka zuita a, ka pial kei hi.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

paite: Amukte thupiak a kipan ka paikik kei a, akam a thute akiphamoh ka an sang in ka kholkhawm zaw hi.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

paite: "Himahleh amah lungsim khek lou ahi a, amah kua'n ahei thei dia? Akha in adeih, huai mah ahih zel hi.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

paite: Kei a dia sehsa ahih ngal a; thil huchibang tampi akiang ah a-om hi.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

paite: Huaiziak in a-omna ah ka buai a; ka ngaihtuah chiang in amah ka lau hi.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

paite: Pathian in ka lungtang abahsakta a, Bangkim hihthei in ahon hihbuaita hi.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

paite: Khomial ma in satkhiak in ka om ngal kei a, ka mai a kipan khomial sah leng akhuh sam kei hi.”
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
